transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for joining today's readiness huddle. As you know, we have one Saturday mobile vaccination clinic available this month, and it can operate at either the Eastside Community Center or the Westside Library. Before I make a final decision on the site and sign the operational plan, I need to hear from each of you. Public health nursing, please report your clinical requirements. Pharmacy logistics, I need your supply requirements. And community outreach, let's hear about access considerations. Once I have all three reports, I'll make the activation decision and get the plan signed.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share an important clinical requirement. This morning I received the updated allocation list from the county nurse coordinator. The list records 31 children aged six months through four years in the Eastside service area, and county policy requires that the Saturday session serving that group use the pediatric mRNA formulation at Eastside Community Center. So from a public health nursing standpoint, our clinical requirements point to Eastside Community Center as the site for this month's clinic.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share a key supply requirement for the site decision. Eastside Community Center has a validated vaccine refrigerator with capacity for 80 doses at 2-8 degrees Celsius, and pharmacy policy requires an opening temperature-log check at 08:00 before any doses are released there. I've verified the refrigerator record with facilities, so the cold-chain storage is confirmed for Eastside.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I'd like to share an important access consideration from community outreach. I've received confirmation from the Eastside Community Center's partner program director: they have 48 appointments lined up beginning at 09:00 this Saturday, and they've already reserved an American Sign Language interpreter for that session. This demonstrates strong community readiness and accessibility planning on the Eastside.
